kind: new corrected-input replay of a pinned finite source search; not verification of archived optimizer output

inputs.source_page_actual_identity: LP2-08 (global image ordinal 25), 255 GP runes; not LP2-25
inputs.adapter: Load exact pinned source functions from Git; remap only its moved PAGES_DIR and REF file paths to exact Git objects. Keep its GP mapping, greedy corpus conversion, key construction, decryption, scoring, IoC, selection, and tuple-sort ordering unchanged.

search.selection: Sort source tuples (score, IoC, offset, mode, first 200 runeglish characters) descending and take first six rows, including both modes and tie order.
search.refinement: Union all integer offsets within plus or minus 200 of each selected coarse offset; lower bound zero; evaluate both source modes at every refined offset. Keep duplicate coarse/refined rows as the source does.
search.criterion: The source's weighted THE/AND/ING/ION/ENT/TIO trigram score on the unbroken GP runeglish text. IoC is a secondary sort key, not a decoding proof.

controls.positive: Construct 255-rune plaintext by repeating GP [TH,E,A,N,D] (visible THEAND), encrypt with the source's own key slice at each of coarse offsets 300 and 1700 in each mode. Each planted exact offset/mode must appear in the source-selected top 100 and round-trip to the planted plaintext. Check an off-grid 137 variant as a documented sensitivity diagnostic, not a gate.
controls.source_equivalence: Compare optimized scorer and selected-row tuples with the literal source functions on all planted controls and at least 40 deterministic pseudo-random short messages; independent checker also rebuilds top-100 rows without importing runner internals.
controls.order_control: 199 deterministic uniform shuffles of the actual 255 rune indices, each re-running the complete coarse-top-six-refined selection with its original source criterion. Seed 20261023. Report rank of the manuscript maximum only as a shuffle-order comparison, not a cipher-model probability or general decryption exclusion.

exclusions: other corpus editions, encodings, offsets, directions, or GP spellings
the follow-on unseeded substitution optimizer p25_hillclimb.py
a claim that a high common-trigram score is meaningful English or a decoded page
a replay of the unavailable historical data/p25_offset_results.txt
